title: The token check is there. It is also useless.
brief: Marcus reviewed the CSRF middleware and it looks right at a glance. Find the line that makes the whole check pass for any request at all.

decoyLines.3: accepting the token from body or header is normal — both are things a cross-site form cannot set
decoyLines.2: reading the expected token from the session is exactly right

attackSuite.payload: Any request against a session that never received a token
attackSuite.label: Skips the check entirely

functionalSuite.value: A form on Aurora's own page carrying its token
functionalSuite.label: Still passes

hints: What happens when the session has no token yet? Trace that path.
A missing expected value should fail closed, not open.
